name: Aluminium-Elko, 47 µF, 6,3 V, ±20 %, SMD 5 x 5,4 mm
replaces_for_this_bom: ENP-00056 (10 µF); keep original part and stock unchanged

verification.mechanical: Existing 5 mm body / 5.3 mm base footprint; 3 x 1.6 mm pads at x=±2.2 mm. Nichicon E=1.3 mm, terminal width 0.5..0.8 mm. Compatible geometry; same nominal 5.4 mm height (datasheet +0.1/-0.2 mm).
verification.electrical: C2 is across +3V3_SYS and GND AFTER D1/D2. 6.3 V rating exceeds 3.3 V rail; 47 µF minimum initial capacitance 37.6 µF. C4 (47 µF tantalum) is the regulator output capacitor BEFORE D1. No claim that C2 meets the LM3940 output-capacitor ESR window.
verification.physical: Soldering, load-step and temperature qualification pending; no measurements claimed.
